rule: Accessories on the same square. Not a new character. Default is the naked square.
how_to_change: Set data-skin on .val8000-square, or call VAL8000_applySkin(el, id).
note: Overlays sit on the VAL8000 square. They do not replace mouth or eye PNGs. Default is unadorned.

skins.name: Unadorned square
skins.title: Naked square
skins.notes: Default. No accessory. Just the VAL8000 square: red eye, idle line, he types in the box.

skins.name: Frequency ribbon
skins.title: Frequency ribbon
skins.notes: Tiny gold Frequency ribbon. Accessory, not a new face.

skins.name: Weekend Update glasses
skins.title: Weekend Update glasses
skins.notes: Thin joke rims. Original. Not a brand.

skins.name: Scientist visor
skins.title: Scientist visor
skins.notes: Lab visor. Does not cover the idle mouth line.

skins.name: Ordinary glasses
skins.title: Ordinary glasses
skins.notes: Original round frames on the square. Not a brand. Not a product photo. Worn preview: worn-glasses-ordinary.png.

skins.name: Camera-frame glasses
skins.title: Camera-frame glasses
skins.notes: Same frames, small camera on the rim. Meta Ray-Ban analog only — original art, no logo, no product photo. Accessory, not a surveillance product, not a keylogger. VAL still types in the box. Worn preview: worn-glasses-camera.png.

skins.name: Monocle
skins.title: Monocle
skins.notes: Swap skin. Original round gold lens on the red-eye square. Same CG gold as ordinary glasses. Not a brand. Not a product photo. Good for Go deeper / sarcasm / Weekend Update scientist beat. Not automatic on insult — insult is the tongue. Worn preview: worn-monocle.png.
skins.when: Swap only. Go deeper / sarcasm / Weekend Update scientist beat. Not automatic on insult.

skins.name: Stripe body
skins.title: Stripe body
skins.notes: Swap skin. Original body paint on the same square: cream field, bold red and black irregular angular stripes. Striped-guitar homage. Circular lens cutout — stripes do not cover the pupil or the rings. Idle mouth stays a thin line, not a pickguard jaw. Teeth, when on, live inside the camera rings. Default remains the naked square.
skins.when: Swap only. Body paint. Not the masthead default.

skins.name: Tessellation tray
skins.title: Tessellation tray
skins.notes: Source slot for cool outputs from Jon's tessellation app. App is not in this repo. Drop files in tessellation/. Patterns to wear, not physics. Not NAV-42, not Fluid-Q, not Q OS.
skins.when: Empty until Jon drops a print.
